description: Make a layer active by name. Recurses into groups; if a name appears more than once, picks the first match in stack order (top-to-bottom). Throws if no layer by that name exists. Foundational for multi-layer workflows — use after ps_duplicate_layer or ps_add_adjustment_layer when you need to focus a specific layer before applying further operations.

name.description: Name of the layer to make active. Recurses into groups; matches the first layer in stack order (top-to-bottom). Throws if no layer by that name exists.

name: ps_select_layer
